title: RYOT Verb Dry Herb Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
RYOT Verb Dry Herb Vaporizer

The RYOT Verb Dry Herb Vaporizer will satisfy even the most experienced users. The vape fits perfectly in the palm of your hand or in your pocket, making it ideal to pack on the go. It also features a stainless steel oven, complete temp control, rapid heat times, and even heating.

The RYOT verb promises quality vapor at a great price. It is perfect for somebody who is either looking to start vaping or scouring the market for a cost-friendly vaporizer. Check out reviews from our customers to learn more about their overall experience using this vape!

The Verb is an overall great vaporizer that can produce smooth, potent vapor.

Purchase yours today!

RYOT Verb DHV Vaporizer features:

- Large bowl for dry herb

- Innovative stay cool smooth draw mouthpiece

- Easy load funneled oven chamber Integrated stainless steel poker tool

- Rapid Heating temperature control

- 8-hour charge/battery life

- Automatic shut off

- OLED display

- Slim hips

- Limited 2-year warranty

- Dimensions: 113mm x 35mm x 19mm

What’s in the Box:

- RYOT Verb Dry Herb Vaporizer

- Micro USB Cable

- Cleaning Brush

- 25 Cotton Swabs

- Poker
